notes: All 43 candidate decisions were read against the exact local definitions, source passages and frozen critiques.
Accepted: two operative truth-standard or bearer meaning shifts, two circular knowledge/shared-bearer objections, and one diversion from semantic work to physical independence.

Shared-content examples with an unsupported existence inference were not automatically labeled circular; limited analogies and unfinished explanatory mechanisms were not automatically labeled equivocation or ignorance.
Belief-bias candidates lacked a separate observable mechanism. No cognitive-bias quota was imposed.
The final dispensability reply receives one red-herring label, not a duplicate equivocation label for the same diversion.
